Open-Source Project 'Bygga' Generates 3D Animated IKEA Assembly Guides with Voice Control

Introduction to Bygga

A new open-source project named Bygga offers an alternative approach to assembling flat-pack furniture by generating 3D, manual-style animated guides for thousands of IKEA products. Developed as a web application and hosted on GitHub, the software renders step-by-step instructions utilizing parametric plan generation and a Three.js line-art stage.

Unlike standard digital solutions that mirror official documents, Bygga programmatically builds guides from public catalog listings rather than storing IKEA's proprietary PDF manuals. Each generated guide includes a direct link back to the official manual on IKEA's website.

Technical Architecture and Features

Built using Next.js 16 (App Router, Cache Components), React 19, and TypeScript, the application relies on plain CSS with Motion rather than an external UI kit. According to the project repository, the rendering engine and parametric plan generator support 1,171 IKEA products across 2,180 sizes for both UK and US ranges.

The application incorporates hands-free voice navigation powered by pre-recorded Kokoro audio clips and Whisper on Together AI. Through an echo-cancelled microphone setup, the system listens for voice commands such as "next" to progress through assembly stages. Additionally, visitors can use Together AI keys to process photo lookups for products not natively stored in the database or utilize an interactive help chat.

Additional utility features include share cards rendered by the core engine, an A4 print view, and service worker caching designed to allow offline access once a guide has been opened. Developers can run the project locally by cloning the repository, installing dependencies, and executing the local development server.

Practical Implications and Verification

For technology enthusiasts and developers, Bygga serves as an example of combining parametric generation, Three.js graphics, and multimodal AI tools in a Next.js environment. Users can inspect the code, run test suites for voice commands and catalog integrity, or contribute to ongoing development tasks such as expanding language support and refining odd furniture geometries.

| Feature | Status / Implementation | |---|---| | Core Framework | Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript | | Rendering Engine | Three.js line-art stage (`src/engine`) | | Catalog Coverage | 1,171 products, 2,180 sizes (UK/US ranges) | | Voice Integration | Kokoro audio clips & Whisper on Together AI | | Licensing | MIT License (Unaffiliated with Inter IKEA Systems B.V.) |

What is Confirmed vs. Unknown

  • Confirmed: The software is available under an MIT license on GitHub, supports a specific catalog of generated product guides, and integrates AI features via Together AI keys.
  • Unknown: The long-term reliability of automated parametric generation for complex or newly released furniture variants remains subject to ongoing script updates.

Readers can examine the codebase, review licensing notices, and verify the project details directly at the Official GitHub Repository.
